shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum have increased by over 2% in the last 24 hours, with broad gains seen across many altcoins.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reflects a neutral sentiment, holding within the 51 to 55 range.
Escalating tensions in the Middle East are driving up oil prices and worsening inflation concerns.
The upcoming FOMC meeting signals prolonged tight monetary policy, which generally poses headwinds for risk assets.
Citigroup has raised its one-year Bitcoin target forecast to $113,000.
